spec.experiment: SG30 SPARK-inspired nonlinear SA affinity sharpening
spec.code_status: Project page says Code (Coming Soon); linked spark-code repository returned 404 on 28 October 2026
spec.parameter_provenance: Expansion 2 and pruning 1e-7 are stated in SPARK main implementation details. Inflation 2.6 and beta 0.6 are fixed paper-ablation peaks, not recovered code defaults and not tuned here.
spec.local_feature_source: Conditional input hidden states after module15 self-attention group normalization, immediately before to_q/to_k/to_v, at 64x64 for calls 10-20
spec.negative_local_cosine: clamp to zero before setting self affinity to 1 and row normalization; explicit SG30 adaptation because SPARK code is unavailable
spec.pruning_semantics: threshold the unnormalized elementwise-power matrix; if all entries of a row are removed, use its pre-pruned row-normalized values
spec.ca: historical selected-module A3 class-word seed unchanged, including known orientation caveat
spec.sa: module15 64x64, calls 10-20 inclusive, 8 heads, original SD scaled-dot-product softmax global graph, observation-wise
spec.sampled_graph_rows: 32 uniformly spaced rows plus up to 16 GT foreground and 16 GT background rows, deterministic; GT used only for post-hoc diagnostics
spec.selection: five fixed VOC folds; raw and R2 selectors separately; registered 0.005/0.010 gain and 4/5 vote rule; S5-I2/I3 diagnostic only; COCO transfer only
spec.storage: per-image counts and reduced graph diagnostics only; no generated images, masks, attention matrices, features or Q/K retained
